task: Per-cell parse fallback for E000 in notebooks (15/92 papers, 16% impact)

files_modified.delta: +~210 lines (added SkippedCell, heuristics for R/bash/cell-magic, extract_notebook_source_with_validation)
+~50 lines (replaced extract_notebook_source call with validation variant; emit per-cell INFO + notebook-no-python-cells)

files_created.purpose: 1 R cell + 2 Python cells (R009/R016 trigger downstream)
3 R cells, no Python -> notebook-no-python-cells INFO

design_decisions: Backward-compat: kept extract_notebook_source(path) returning (source, mappings) by delegating to the new function and dropping the third tuple element.

Order of cell classification: cell_magic (%%) first, then non_python_r, then non_python_bash, then ast.parse fallback. This keeps %%bash diagnostics labelled as cell_magic (more specific) rather than non_python_bash.
R-language heuristic requires BOTH '<-' (whitespace-bounded) AND one of library(/function(/c(/read.csv to avoid false positives on Python 'a < -1' comparisons.
Bash heuristic looks at the FIRST non-comment line for cd/mkdir/for-do.
Per-cell INFO diagnostics use rule_id='E000' rule_name='notebook-cell-skipped' with severity=INFO; respect severity_threshold filtering.
Empty-virtual-source after skipping -> single E000 INFO 'notebook-no-python-cells' (not ERROR). nbformat<4 / malformed JSON still produces E000 ERROR (legacy preserved).

compatibility_risks.risk: Public API extract_notebook_source kept as 2-tuple wrapper around new function. Any external caller using 2-tuple unpacking continues to work; callers wanting skip info must use extract_notebook_source_with_validation.

Existing leaky_notebook.ipynb test (test_notebook_basic / test_notebook_clean / test_notebook_directory_scan / test_notebook_cell_location / test_notebook_malformed) all still pass — line numbers in that fixture were not affected because no cells get skipped (all are valid Python).

If a notebook contains both R-style assignments AND legitimate Python comparisons in OTHER cells, only cells where the R heuristic matches both conditions are skipped. Pure-Python cells with 'a < -1' inside but no library/function/c/read.csv hint pass cleanly. Verified via test_unicode_only_string_no_false_skip + manual review of regex.

Cell-magic detection treats ANY %% line as cell magic. If someone uses an ipynb cell that BEGINS with a string literal containing '%%' as the first non-empty line (unlikely in practice), it would be mis-skipped. Acceptable given real-world notebook conventions.

Per-cell INFO can increase diagnostic volume in formatters/SARIF output for notebooks with many non-Python cells. Output remains correctly typed; consumers filtering by severity 'error' or 'warning' will not see these.
No existing R009/R022 fixture line-number assertions broke (verified by full pytest run). No remediation needed.

notes_for_main_process: All 134 plugin tests pass (124 pre-existing + 10 new). Coverage on engine.py and notebook.py both at 88% (>=85% target). The fix transforms a fatal E000 ERROR into per-cell INFO records, allowing analysis to continue on well-formed Python cells. This should reduce the 15/92 (16%) E000 hit rate by allowing R/bash/magic-mixed notebooks (PR-EXP-0157, PR-EXP-0072, PR-EXP-0152) to be partially analysed instead of fully aborting.
